say:7:1120732006:1.text: The Claw who came to the rescue saved Rumon all by himself! He was so brave!
say:7:1120732006:1.source_cn: 那个来救人的流沙之爪，他身手很敏捷，而且孤身一人来救同...

say:8:1120732007:1.text: But he's still a Quicksand Claw, and the locals hate them! That old clan leader would never let him fight in the Bestial Brawl!
say:8:1120732007:1.source_cn: 可、可他是流沙之爪呀！流沙之爪之前欺骗劫掠了那么多当地...

say:9:1120732008:1.text: Hmm... I don't think that little croc was lying. We saw in the Claw camp earlier that many were just forced into working for Ferranc. I don't believe all the Claws are actually evil.
say:9:1120732008:1.source_cn: 唔，我觉得那只小鳄鱼说的不像假话。咱们之前在流沙之爪的...

say:10:1120732009:1.text: If I'm wrong and they're up to no good, we can take this chance to go find out. Then, we can look for other Maulers!
